newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up as blue chips gain.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up as blue chips gain.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended higher as the blue chip shares in engineering, pharmaceuticals and leather sectors gained by retail buying, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index gained 5.74 points or 0.66 percent to 867.79 on turnover of 54.6 million taka. Gainers led losers by 71 to 58.
Brokers said the prices of most shares were attractive after they fell over a long period. "Investors wanted to take advantage of a cheaper market," said one broker.
Singer Bangladesh gained 46 taka to 3,995, Square Pharma rose 13 to 779 and Bata Shoe was up 5.0 to 110.
